long_biography.plain_text:
Marco Giovanni Berri built his career in the international cotton trade. He became a director of the British company originally incorporated as I.C.T. International Cotton Trading in 1999 and held a controlling interest in the business. From Switzerland, he also represented ICT Trading at industry meetings and arbitration-focused forums, working within a commodity market shaped by contracts, quality standards and cross-border logistics.

The group later extended its merchant operations to Dubai through ICT Cotton DMCC, with Berri named among its senior executives. The Dubai company was linked to the British and Swiss firms and traded substantial annual cotton volumes. Berri's British directorship ended in January 2026, and that company was dissolved three months later after more than twenty-six years on the register.
